properties.headline: Frost Advisory issued October 17 at 11:59AM EDT until October 18 at 8:00AM EDT by NWS Detroit/Pontiac MI
properties.description:
* WHAT...Temperatures dropping into the lower and mid 30s results in
areas of frost late tonight and early Sunday morning.

* WHERE...Lapeer, Lenawee, Livingston, Macomb, Monroe, Oakland,
Sanilac, St. Clair, Washtenaw, and Wayne Counties.

* WHEN...From 3 AM to 8 AM EDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Frost could harm temperature sensitive vegetation.
Outdoor plants may be killed if left uncovered.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...A heavier frost is expected toward the Ohio
border and outside of metro Detroit where the wind becomes calm.
Southwest wind in the 5 to 15 mph range is a more reliable limiting
factor for frost toward the Tri Cities.
properties.instruction: Take steps now to protect tender plants from the cold.

properties.areaDesc: Pinellas, FL
properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued October 17 at 11:40AM EDT until October 17 at 1:45PM EDT by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Pinellas County in west central Florida...

* WHEN...Until 145 PM EDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1140 AM EDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 1 and 2 inches of rain have
fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 2 inches are expected over
the area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Clearwater, Largo, Pinellas Park, Seminole, Indian Rocks Beach,
Ridgecrest, Harbor Bluffs, South Highpoint, Bay Pines, Treasure
Island, Madeira Beach, Belleair, Redington Shores, Belleair
Bluffs, Belleair Beach, Redington Beach and Indian Shores.
- https://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.
